## F — Your Driver’s License
Research index: Your Driver’s License; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 52 and 60 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 6 through 16, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC01-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC01-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC01-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC01-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC01-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-LICENSE-CROSSPAGE — Resolve the practice-driving timing condition spanning physical pages eight and nine before asserting it from one registered page.
VERIFY: ME-LICENSE-TRANSFER — Verify the categorical passenger-car transfer written-test waiver against current issuer policy; first-time examination requirements are kept separate.
VERIFY: ME-LICENSE-POINTS — Confirm current administrative warning and suspension point levels before stable learner display.
VERIFY: ME-LICENSE-REVOCATION — Resolve indefinite revocation wording and the nearby class-specific durations before learner display.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
